Text.Text: Welcome to Supplies. I am Quartermaster Tobin Raye. I have counted everything on this station, and most of it is missing. If you want work, I have a list.
This Wood is dry and straight. That puts six crates back in service, and Supplies pays its debts. Here is your pay.
You are back from the supply caches. Did you bring me all six pieces of Wood?

I am short of crates. I ship ore in them, and the Mynocks have eaten the glue out of half my stock. I can rebuild them if I have timber. There is Wood in the supply caches around the station. Search the caches, collect six pieces of Wood and bring them back to me here in Supplies.
Good. Bring me six pieces of Wood. You can get them from the supply caches around the station.
I still need six pieces of Wood. You can get them from the supply caches around the station. Bring them to me here when you have them all.
They are round and smooth, just as the captain described. If the glassware arrives whole, I owe that captain a drink. Here is your pay.
You are back from the supply caches. Did you find all four Viscaran Pebbles for me?

I have one. The labs ship glassware to Viscara and it arrives broken. A freighter captain told me to pack it in Viscaran Pebbles. Some came up in the last supply drop and ended up scattered through the supply caches around the station. Search the caches, collect four Viscaran Pebbles and bring them back to me here in Supplies.
Good. Bring me four Viscaran Pebbles. You can get them from the supply caches around the station.
I still need four Viscaran Pebbles. You can get them from the supply caches around the station. Bring them to me here when you have them all.
That is ten pieces at a good weight, so this week's book is closed. Czerka pays a quota bonus, and for once it goes to someone who earned it.
You are back from the Maintenance Level. Did you mine all ten pieces of Raw Veldite?

No, we are behind. Avix Tatham's miners have been pulled onto repairs, so nobody is digging. There are Veldite veins on the Maintenance Level, if you can mine them. Mine the veins, collect ten pieces of Raw Veldite and bring them back to me here in Supplies, and I can close this week's book.
Good. Bring me ten pieces of Raw Veldite. You can get them by mining the Veldite veins on the Maintenance Level of CZ-220.
Yes, he did, but his job was a lesson to teach you mining. Mine is a real shortfall. I need ten more pieces of Raw Veldite from the veins on the Maintenance Level.
I still need ten pieces of Raw Veldite. You can get them by mining the Veldite veins on the Maintenance Level of CZ-220. Bring them to me here when you have them all.
Six ingots, and they are still warm. That keeps the freighter contract alive. Here is the refined rate, paid in full.
You are back from the refinery. Did you bring me all six ingots of Refined Veldite?

No, it is further behind than the raw ore. I owe six ingots of Refined Veldite on the next freighter, and the refinery crew is in sickbay. You have seen the refinery. Smelt Raw Veldite there until you have six ingots of Refined Veldite, then bring them back to me here in Supplies.
Good. Bring me six ingots of Refined Veldite. You can get them by smelting Raw Veldite at the station's refinery.
I still need six ingots of Refined Veldite. You can get them by smelting Raw Veldite at the station's refinery. Bring them to me here when you have them all.
None is still a number, I suppose, so I have logged it. Thank you. Here is your pay.
You are back from Dr. Marn. How many splints does sickbay have?

Yes, I do. Sickbay has not filed a stock count in a month. I need you to find Dr. Ilsa Marn and ask her how many splints she has. Sickbay is full, so she works out of the Recreation room on this deck. Then come back to me here in Supplies with the number.
Good. Ask Dr. Ilsa Marn how many splints she has, then come back to me here in Supplies. Sickbay is full, so she works out of the Recreation room on this deck.
You still need to ask Dr. Ilsa Marn how many splints sickbay has. She works out of the Recreation room on this deck. Come back to me here once you have the number.
A whole bulkhead. Of course he does. I have logged the order. Thank you, and here is your pay.
You are back from Maintenance. Did Foreman Ketch give you his parts order?

It closes today, and Maintenance has not sent me their order. Foreman Dorn Ketch never leaves his post. I need you to go to Ketch by the Fabrication Terminals, on this deck, and ask him for his parts order. Then come back to me here in Supplies and tell me what he needs.
Good. Ask Foreman Dorn Ketch by the Fabrication Terminals for his parts order, then come back to me here in Supplies with it.
You still need to ask Foreman Dorn Ketch by the Fabrication Terminals for his parts order. Come back to me here once you have it.
You are the first thing on this station that is exactly where the book says it is. Here is your bonus, station hand.
There you are, our new station hand. Your name is on the roster. Are you ready to collect your bonus?

So I hear. Dr. Marn has her Mynock Teeth, Foreman Ketch has his Maintenance Level back, and my ore book is closed. That is three departments helped. Czerka has a line on the roster for that, called station hand. It comes with a bonus and no extra duties. All you need to do is say yes. Shall I sign you on?
Good. I have entered you on the roster as a station hand. Speak to me again here in Supplies to collect your bonus.
Thank you. Please go back to Dr. Marn in the Recreation room and break the news to her gently.
I have Dr. Marn's manifest here. She ordered synthskin, splints and antiseptic, and all three are on the shipment that has not arrived yet. Tell her I have moved sickbay to the top of my list.
Thank you. Please go back to Foreman Ketch by the Fabrication Terminals and tell him. He will not like it.
Let me see Ketch's report. Three lifts are down, there are six coolant leaks, and one bulkhead has claw marks. Tell him the parts are logged, and that claw marks are not a parts problem.
Goodbye, Quartermaster. Good luck with the count.
What else is on your list?
Yes, that is all six of them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you six pieces of Wood.
Not right now, Quartermaster.
What supplies are you short of?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the pieces of Wood you asked for.
Yes, that is all four of them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you four Viscaran Pebbles.
Not right now, Quartermaster.
Do you have any unusual orders to fill?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the Viscaran Pebbles you asked for.
Yes, that is all ten of them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you ten pieces of Raw Veldite.
Not right now, Quartermaster.
Didn't Avix Tatham already have me mine Veldite?
Is the station meeting its ore quota?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the pieces of Raw Veldite you asked for.
Yes, that is all six of them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you six ingots of Refined Veldite.
Not right now, Quartermaster.
Is the refined ore shipment on schedule?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the ingots of Refined Veldite you asked for.
She has none. She is using deck plating and optimism.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will ask Dr. Marn about her splints.
Not right now, Quartermaster.
Do you need a stock count taken?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you wanted me to ask Dr. Marn.
He wants three lift controllers, coolant line and a whole bulkhead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will get the foreman's parts order.
Not right now, Quartermaster.
Is the parts order closing soon?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need from Foreman Ketch.
Yes, I am ready for my bonus.
Give me a moment first.
Give me a moment first.
Yes, please sign me on as a station hand.
Not just yet, Quartermaster.
I have been helping out all around the station.
I will tell her that sickbay is top of the list.
Not right now.
Dr. Marn sent me to ask where her medical supplies are.
I will pass that on to Foreman Ketch.
Not right now.
Foreman Ketch asked me to bring you his shift report.
